patterns: APPSC asks direct single-fact items: tutelary deity (Hariti), who enlarged Amaravati (Vasishthiputra), acharya-vihara, sect-centre pairs.
'Wrong pair' questions on Buddhist sects/ancient names (Purvasaila, Aparasaila, Siddharthaka-Guntupalli) are a recurring trap.
Other PSCs ask symbol-event (wheel = first sermon), chaitya vs vihara, Ayaka pillars = Amaravati, Karle = largest Hinayana chaitya.
App leans heavily on multi-statement and 'how many correct' formats and on secondary-note trivia (size records, Thotlakonda survey), deeper than APPSC.
App includes off-topic patronage/Reddi items filed here.
